warnings: Elevation 4, the letter-axis face opposite A-09. Grid bubbles run A B C D left to right.

*** THIS IS THE ONLY ELEVATION SHOWING ALL THREE ROOF MASSES AT ONCE *** -- the main two-storey hip at +6.65, the lower south-west wing, and the single-storey wing at +3.80 -- and all three carry the same 25° pitch mark. Only the low metal-sheet roof between them is labelled 'SLOPE' with no angle, which remains the one unstated pitch in the set.
Both level stacks are printed: the two-storey one on the left (+0.00 / +0.40 / +3.40 / +6.65) and the single-storey one on the right (+0.00 / +3.40 / +3.80), exactly as on A-08.
A 2.30 / 2.70 SUB-CHAIN splits the C-D bay -- it sets out the single-storey wing's end wall at 2.30 m from grid C. That figure appears on no other sheet.
Three voids ('โล่ง') on this face, more than any other elevation.
